output.summary: The 98.1% figure is an artifact of the KPI definition: revisions replace the original promised date. Revisions jumped fivefold in each center right after the bonus took effect (Pell Junction later, when it became eligible). They shifted to Operational-Capacity reasons, were entered late and were rarely notified. RouteWise went live at Northgate only in October, so it cannot explain the Northgate jump, and it has no on-time analysis. Brightwell's logs show 81% on time against 98.4% reported, and lateness complaints rose 35% while damage and billing complaints stayed flat. Driver shortage is plausible but unadjusted. Suspend the claim and audit against original dates, re-base the incentive, and do not raise the bonus or launch the campaign. Recomputing on-time against original dates (Q1) is the most valuable next evidence.
